procedure: Header strips rendered with pdfplumber page.crop(...).to_image(resolution=300); ambiguous cells zoomed at 600 dpi (1200 dpi for the cell-token reads recorded under cell_token_repairs). Labels read left-to-right per page.
structure_note: Column-split pagination, unlike Union's row-block scheme: p2+p3+p4 are one table (23 precincts + TOTAL; p2 = columns 1-11, p3 = columns 12-22, p4 = column 23 'Porters Chapel' + TOTAL, a narrow 2-column page whose data lines carry only 2 numeric tokens so extract_table_page must retry with min_columns=2). p5+p6+p7 are a SECOND 23-precinct table with the same column split (p5 = columns 1-11, p6 = columns 12-22, p7 = 'Porters Chapel' + TOTAL, the second narrow 2-column page). Its leading row block is the CONTINUATION of the Circuit Court 9-2 section whose header prints last on p2/p3/p4: M. James 'Jim' Chaney Jr.'s row prints at the top of p5/p6/p7, ahead of the local zone's first header box ('Warren County-County Court Judge'), so carry_pages declares 5/6/7. Everything after that section's row is the local-races table (County Court Judge etc.), out of scope. Each table page reprints ALL its office headers (operator strips: 'United States-Senate' visible on p2, p3 and p4), so p3->p4 are per-page continuations, not repeat-group members sharing one row stream. Total check: Colom 2992 (p2) + 5260 (p3) + 324 (p4) = 8576 = printed TOTAL; Chaney 3630 (p5) + 6201 (p6, Life = printed 749) + 714 (p7) = 10545 = printed TOTAL on p7.
truncation_note: Medgar Foundation, Eagle Lake Methodist, International Paper are page-edge truncations in the 2026 general recap; full names taken from the same county's 2026 primary precinct file (20260310__ms__primary__warren__precinct.csv), whose printed names match every truncated prefix. Yokena verified by 600 dpi zoom (matches the 2024 general spelling as well); 'Life' is complete (narrow column). p4's Chancery section header loses its first two characters in the TEXT LAYER only - the rendered page prints the full 'Chancery Court 9-2-Chancery District 9-2' (the same label p2/p3 carry) - hence the 'ancery' repair in the label-repair mechanism.
local_note: p5/p6/p7 also carry the local-races table (Warren County-County Court Judge, Election Commission, JCJ Justice Court, School Board 3/4); local sections' rows are out of scope per the no-local-offices convention and drop via the parse's unknown-header route (recorded in dropped_local_rows, never gated). Some local cells print 'X' (non-numeric); including in the scoped Circuit Court 9-2 (Chaney) row, an X cell reads as column-position evidence only, never a votes value -- a blank becomes 0 only when that row's printed total proves it.
cell_token_repairs_note: Render-verified per cell at 1200 dpi (cache/2026-general-text/w_z_*.png) and then confirmed by the county's printed TOTAL arithmetic (both anchors above). p3 Colom/American Legion prints 582 - the layer merges an invisible '1' glyph into the right-aligned cell; p3 Eller/Calvary Indiana prints 273 the same way; p3 G. Thompson/Calvary Old 27 prints 484 - the Times-Italic small-glyph run decodes as 'AO.' while rendering '484'; p3 Lawson/Lee Rd Fire prints 617 - the trailing '!' glyph prints as the column rule. p6 Chaney/Life prints 749 (the same invisible '1' merge; the 10545 anchor proves it). Applied only to tokens already in a numeric column on the declared page.
